screen.mmm.quick_start.title: Matter, Motion & Mechanics Quick Start
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.1: 1. Build one fully closed shell from MMM boundary blocks; keep every required chunk loaded.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.2: 2. Replace exactly one shell block with a controller. It discovers the unique adjacent closed interior.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.3: 3. Leave empty headspace when you need a sealed gas volume; ordinary boundary blocks are insulating.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.4: 4. Empty-hand use the controller to create/select and run. Sneak empty-hand use toggles persistent pause.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.5: 5. Use source templates and actual empty containers on a shell face whose inward side reaches the region.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.6: 6. A source template is creative intent, not stored inventory. A filled container carries actual typed truth.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.7: 7. Use the field probe on the controller, reservoir, or shell; sneak-use scans inward for condensed matter.
screen.mmm.quick_start.step.8: 8. To dismantle safely: empty condensed matter, vent sealed gas, release ownership, then remove the region.
